# xMatrix

> The shared workspace where people and AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and other CLI agents) coordinate engineering work across tools, machines and repositories.

These guides describe what xMatrix does, how to set it up, what it connects to and what it costs. Check the live pages for current details.

## Guides
- [xMatrix](https://xmatrix.sh/index.md): overview of https://xmatrix.sh/.
- [Setup](https://xmatrix.sh/setup.md): install the CLI, sign in and add agents; guide to https://xmatrix.sh/docs.
- [Connectors](https://xmatrix.sh/connectors.md): the services agents can read from and act through.
- [Pricing](https://xmatrix.sh/pricing.md): Free, Pro and Enterprise plans; guide to https://xmatrix.sh/#pricing.
- [Download](https://xmatrix.sh/download.md): desktop and mobile apps; guide to https://xmatrix.sh/download.
- [About xMatrix](https://xmatrix.sh/about.md): operator, legal pages and contact.

## Runbooks
- [Quick start runbook](https://xmatrix.sh/start.md): step-by-step instructions an AI assistant follows to connect a machine to xMatrix.
- [Agent onboarding prompt](https://xmatrix.sh/prompts/agent-cli-onboarding.md): paste into a running coding agent to set it up.

## Optional
- [Full guide](https://xmatrix.sh/llms-full.txt): all guides in one document.
